summary_up_top.suggest: Move the opening boxed stats and lead sentence above navigation clutter so mobile readers see the core takeaway immediately.

edits.why: Navigation elements and breadcrumbs trap the actual article lead below the fold on mobile screens.

edits.why: Complex legal authorizations and statutory timelines are easier to parse in a mobile-friendly structured table than in dense paragraphs.
edits.how: Convert the legal clauses and corresponding time limits into a two-column summary table.
